messages:
maria: Heads up — large EU prospect is conditioned on ISO + GDPR data residency for private deployments. Sales asked to escalate. We also have the Q2 feature roadmap (embedding cost reductions + rerank improvements). Need a quick call on prioritization: ship features or prioritize certs to close the deal?

alex: How big is the deal in ARR? timeline?

sam: ~ $1.2M ARR committed annually, but they require ISO or equivalent controls + regional hosting and a signed DPA. Timeline they want: start within 3 months.

jordan: ISO is a heavy lift (external audit, long prep). SOC2 Type I/II has overlap but also takes weeks. GDPR work is more product/legal integration (DPAs, DSAR process). We can scope a minimal controls path to unblock sales.

maria: Let's do a quick RICE ballpark to compare.
```
Compliance MVP RICE:
Impact = 8 (large deal + similar prospects)
Reach = 10 accounts in pipeline
Confidence = 0.6
Effort = ~8 eng-weeks + legal
Score = 8 * 10 * 0.6 / 8 = 6

Rerank feature RICE:
Impact = 5
Reach = 200 customers using search
Confidence = 0.7
Effort = 12 eng-weeks
Score = 5 * 200 * 0.7 / 12 ≈ 5.8
```

alex: Those rough numbers suggest compliance edges out the rerank feature by a hair, given immediate revenue and strategic accounts. Also consider cost of delay to existing customers if we shift engineers.

nina: From legal: we can draft a DPA + addendum to cover EU residency + KMS in-region quickly. ISO certificate itself will take longer; we can offer SOC2 readiness + Type I target in contract.

jordan: Operational note — enabling EU-region hosting will increase infra cost (estimated +20% for Dedicated pools) and needs infra changes (replication, KMS integration). Need finance sign-off.

maria: Proposal for sequencing: 1) Compliance-first MVP (DPA + region hosting for rest + KMS keys in EU + audit readiness docs) — target 6–8 weeks. 2) Ship minimal feature work in parallel for low-effort wins. 3) Kick off ISO as a parallel program with a PM and engineering lead (longer runway). We can do canary deployments for the customer on a Dedicated pool.

sam: :thumbsup: Sales can accept that if we add a contractual SLA milestone and a credit clause for delays. I'll confirm with the buyer.

alex: Let's add concrete PRD acceptance criteria: 'EU data at rest stored in EU region; customer-managed keys (KMS) option; audit logs exported and retained 12 months; SOC2 readiness checklist completed for Type I.' I'll sketch a PRD snippet tonight.

maria: If we're aligned I'll break into tickets and owners. Quick poll: Compliance-first MVP + parallel feature backlog?
reactions: :+1: from jordan, :+1: from alex, :+1: from sam, :thinking_face: from nina (contract language to confirm)

ops-bot: Reminder: infra ticket #5432 exists for region replication and feature flags. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/5432

nina: I'll draft the DPA addendum and a timeline. Need CFO sign-off for extra infra spend. @lena (finance) — pinging you for budget review.

maria: Thanks all — I'll follow up with owners and a standing sync to track the compliance MVP milestones.
